title: Base Rate of a Mobile Wallet Shortfall Re-Credit by Cause of the Shortfall
content:
Treasury rate-basis note for **Mobile Wallet** shortfall re-credits.

**Rule.** How the shortfall arose is read by comparing the exchange rate applied on the transfer's latest credit-sent entry with the transfer's locked rate, and it sets the base rate of the shortfall re-credit:

| Latest credit-sent entry | How the shortfall arose | Base rate |
|---|---|---|
| exchange rate applied below the locked rate | a conversion below the locked rate | the booking-day mid-market rate implied by the locked rate: the locked rate divided by one minus the margin the transfer carried over 100, rounded half up to 4 decimals |
| exchange rate applied equal to the locked rate, and the amount it delivered less than the disclosed amount to be credited | a deduction on the way | the locked rate multiplied by one plus 0.5 times the margin the transfer carried over 100, rounded half up to 4 decimals |
| any other case | | the locked rate |

The margin the transfer carried is the tier's exchange-rate margin, less the tier's reduction in percentage points when the principal collected on the transfer (its funds-received entries) is at or above the tier's reduction threshold.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: locked rate 55.0000, margin carried 1.70 percent)

| Latest credit-sent entry | Base rate |
|---|---|
| applied 54.1000 | 55.0000 divided by 0.983 is 55.951169..., rounded to 55.9512 |
| applied 55.0000, delivered 43000.00 against a disclosed 44000.00 | 55.0000 multiplied by 1.0085 is 55.4675 |
| applied 55.0000, delivered the full disclosed 44000.00 | 55.0000 |
| applied 55.2000 | 55.0000 |
